item.description: Discover your family story at our Family Search Center You will find our center in the Lakeport building in the room next to the nursery. Local volunteers can help jumpstart your family history journey. Our center is staffed on Tuesdays from 1pm - 4pm, reach us in person or by phone \(707\) 280-9545 during those hours. All services provided in centers are free. You’ll enjoy: Personalized help Center guests can receive personal help from volunteers in one of more than 5,400 centers worldwide. Access to technology Centers offer complimentary access to computers, internet, and subscription family history websites. Available resources vary by location. Access to exclusive records Visitors to FamilySearch Centers get special access to images of historical records that are only available in centers. item.description:
DATE AND TIME: Thursdays, 5:30 PM
Unlock your inner strength and find your flow. Belly dancing with Raja is an innovative fusion class that blends the rhythmic artistry of belly dance with the high-energy benefits of aerobics. Designed to be both a cardiovascular challenge and a deep toning session, this class focuses on the “powerhouse” of the body—your core.
By layering fluid, isolative movements over an athletic aerobic base, you will challenge your muscles in ways traditional gym workouts can’t reach.
What to Expect in Belly Dancing Class
• Core-Centric Power: Use undulations and shimmies to engage deep abdominal muscles for a tighter, stronger midsection.
• Functional Stability: Improve your balance and posture through controlled, hip-driven movements and low-impact aerobic footwork.
• Total Body Toning: Build lean muscle in your legs, glutes, and arms while maintaining a constant, heart-pumping pace.

Join us at Taps on the River in historic downtown Petaluma! We'll be performing our upbeat blend of original alternative, progressive, rock, with our own spin on classic hits you know and love from the 60s-90s (e.g. Beatles, CCR, Doors, Police, Men At Work, Hendrix, Pink Floyd, Tears for Fears, Steely Dan, U2, and more).

Diana Dreams is a singer/songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, educator, caregiver, and community organizer from Sonoma County, CA. She holds a BFA from CalArts & a Master of Music in Opera & vocal performance from UCLA. She has performed in at least 6 countries, sung in 6\+ languages, written hundreds of songs and instrumental pieces, performed as a soloist in operas, oratorios, requiems, and choral concerts, founded multiple musical groups, and given multiple world premieres of new music by living composers. item.title: Photographer Becky Jaffe to present at the Napa Valley Photographic Society — Mon Aug 24, 7:00 PM — Napa Senior Center
item.description:
Please join fellow photography enthusiasts for Becky Jaffe’s presentation on The Art of Seeing.
A photographer and educator, Becky Jaffe exhibits her photography in over forty museums and galleries nationwide, curates multimedia exhibits in community art centers and greenhouses, teaches Art of Seeing courses for fine art photographers, and judges photography competitions for over a dozen Northern California camera clubs. Her photographs have been published in LensWork, SHOTS Magazine, Der Greif, the San Francisco Chronicle, and Bay Nature Magazine. She was the 2019 Artist-in-Residence at the University of California at Berkeley Botanical Garden, where she teaches photography workshops that cross-pollinate the arts and sciences, using an artistic lens to study ethnobotany, ecology, and evolutionary biology.
